text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten—
the grand race closing 
out this year's dirt season.
Oguri Cap and 
Super Creek had come to watch the 
spectacle.

With the two who set the Arima Kinen 
ablaze watching on, Inari One heads onto 
the grand stage of Oi to claim the "top 
spot" among regional racers.
